item.title: I will have a few talks at Kernel Recipes, LPC, and Open Source Summit EU 2026
item.description: I will present and discuss below topics in Kernel Recipes, LPC, and Open Source Summit Europe in following weeks. In Kernel Recipes 26 next week, I will present how DAMON can be turned into Data Access Monitoring-based System Operation Engine. The title of the talk is “DAMOS: The Smart Cruise Control for RAM”. In Linux Plumbers 26 in the week of 2026-10-05, I will have two sessions. In the Device and Specific Purpose Memory Management Micro-conference (Monday), I will present and discuss DAMON extension project for memory tiering and general NUMA memory management.
